answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 31650 Country: ZA Title: When one is making wudu and his hair above the beard on the side by the forehead is thick does water need to go through that hair? Question: When one is making wudu and his hair above the beard on the side by the forehead is thick does water need to go through that hair? Answer ID: 31650 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 707/L=256/tl=1432) It is not necessary to let the water reach to the root of thin beard. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
